title: Role Cascade Visualizer and Impact Strip
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, horizontally-scrolling ‘Role Cascade Visualizer’ and complementary ‘Impact Strip’ to help admins understand downstream effects when editing or rolling out role changes at org and workspace levels. The feature must surface where a role is granted (direct vs inherited), the set of resources it affects, how many users will be impacted, and quick actions to preview or rollback changes. This is intended for the Console’s Roles & Audit pages and should integrate with the existing access review flows.
user_stories: As an admin, I want to see which workspaces and resources inherit a role so I can assess blast radius before making changes.
As a security reviewer, I want to preview the list of users affected by a role change and export the result for an audit.
As an SRE, I want a concise view that shows when automatic role rollouts last ran and whether they passed health checks so I can triage failures quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizer shows source of grant (direct/parent-org/role-template) with distinct color tokens.
Impact Strip summarizes affected workspaces, resource types (routes, models, projects), and approximate user counts in a single row for quick scanning.
Hovering a node shows a compact preview card with a sample of up to 10 affected identities and links to their user profiles.
Preview mode simulates applying a permission change and shows a changelist without mutating backend state.
Design assets include responsive states for narrow (mobile) and wide (desktop) Console layouts and accessibility annotations (ARIA labels and keyboard flows).
Prototype validated with at least two PM/Eng reviews and one security audit checklist pass.

decisions: Render nodes with 3 visual tiers: Source (where grant originated), Scope (workspace/project), Resource Type (route/model/console).
Aggregate user counts at workspace level; show sample user list on demand rather than full enumeration to avoid PII exposure.
Preview mode will be read-only client-side diff generated from backend dry-run API to guarantee no accidental mutations.
Expose an opt-in sensitive-perms filter that highlights changes touching high-risk privileges.
open_issues: Backend API needs an endpoint for role-inheritance-paths + workspace aggregates (ENG-1893).
Export flow must include RBAC checks to ensure only authorized auditors can download CSVs.
Performance budget: visualizer initial render must complete within 300ms for <50 nodes on standard customer datasets.
